speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Boerhaave Syndrome (Esophageal Rupture)

I am deeply concerned by your history of forceful vomiting followed by sudden chest pain and choking; this clinical picture strongly suggests a tear in your esophagus. We need to confirm this immediately with a water-soluble contrast esophagram, as a standard CT scan might miss the leak.
